description.en: This adult-male Megaloceros giganteus has broad palmated bare antlers above a robust, long-legged deer body. Coat, colour, stance and precise antler details are interpretive, allowing individual variation rather than asserting a fixed specimen-exact pattern.
description.zh: 此成年雄性大角鹿 Megaloceros giganteus 具有结实的长腿鹿体和宽阔掌状的无茸鹿角。毛被、颜色、站姿与精确角形细节为解释性复原，考虑个体差异，不主张固定的逐标本精确形态。

frozen_scientific_scope.acceptance_boundary: Preparation is not model QA, technical PASS, GPU/scene verification, user acceptance, publication approval or deployment.
frozen_scientific_scope.budget_reason: A practical 18k ceiling leaves room for deliberate torso/head lofts, joint transitions and closed curved antler palms with unequal tapered points. It is a ceiling, not a polygon target. Eight materials and forty primitives retain editable semantic parts without excessive draw calls.

feature_obligations.criterion: Adult male giant-deer identity and huge bilateral antler-to-body relationship remain readable at thumbnail scale.
Palmation has irregular pointed margins, beam/pedicle transitions, a real curved volume and preserved negative spaces; no reconstruction of broken fossil edges as living antler tips.
Robust cervical/shoulder support integrates into a cervid trunk and long distal limbs without turning into moose or bison anatomy.
Coat palette, modest withers contour and exact antler branching are disclosed as interpretation; no claim to a measured individual.

frozen_scientific_scope.final_evidence: Four exact-export GLB views: front, side, top and perspective. Perspective may reuse preview byte-for-byte. No default turntable. Add a local view only for an actual unresolved feature and record the reason.
frozen_scientific_scope.gray_model_gate: Inspect low-cost front, side and elevated oblique views before final materials/renders; add top only if antler sweep or ear clearance remains unclear. Reject a twig-only or flat-paddle crown, lumpy primitive torso, thin unsupported neck, hidden/fused limbs or broken joint flow.
frozen_scientific_scope.intended_use: Static educational gallery asset, whole-animal silhouette and moderate-distance inspection; no animation, rig, habitat base or scientific measurement use.
frozen_scientific_scope.material_profile: palette-only static original geometry, opaque Principled/glTF-compatible materials; no image textures or reference-image embedding

shape_gate.en: Shape criterion: huge flattened palmated antlers above a sturdy deer body. Retain this anatomical combination when compared with nearby forms; a name, scale or pose change alone does not qualify.
shape_gate.zh: 形态判据：粗壮鹿体上方的巨大扁掌状角。须与相近形态对照保留这一结构组合；仅改名称、尺寸或姿态不成立。

frozen_scientific_scope.pose: Quiet four-foot stance, head held approximately forward and slightly above the withers, with no dramatic head turn; mild fore/aft leg stagger exposes all four limbs. Antlers approximately bilateral with controlled natural asymmetry, not extreme trophy symmetry.
required_next_stages: Actual runtime/exporter probe and pinned dependencies
Original deterministic maker work in the same directory
Cheap gray-model structural self-check before polish
Source geometry and exact-GLB checks with Khronos validation
Two isolated rebuilds with semantic digest comparison
Four exact-export views and fresh independent visual/factual/specification review
Reader-format preflight after a genuine independent PASS, using verified current reader

scale.basis: Working artistic scale near museum-reported adult size. Only the approximate size class is evidence-backed; these exact model numbers are not specimen measurements.
scale.tolerance: Shoulder height ±8%; antler spread/shoulder height 1.55–1.80. Body proportions and crown depth remain shape-review targets, not fossil measurements.

scientific_limits.en: Body covering, coloration, stance, exact mass, antler point count and all unsourced dimensions are interpretive. Skeletal mounts may include restored parts; the Cork material is incomplete. Antler asymmetry and proportions varied among individuals. This design does not establish a fixed coat pattern, a precise shoulder hump profile, or an extinction cause/date.
scientific_limits.zh: 体表、颜色、站姿、确切体重、角尖数量及无测量来源的尺寸均为解释性设计。博物馆骨架可能含复原部分，科克标本不完整；个体鹿角形态存在差异。本设计不确定固定毛色纹样、精确肩隆轮廓或灭绝原因与日期。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original refined-low-poly living reconstruction of one adult male Megaloceros giganteus with fully grown bare antlers, informed by named museum skeletal references. A generalized animal, not a scan, specimen replica, phylogenetic diagnosis or measured anatomical restoration.
shape_requirements: Silhouette first: a very wide pair of palmated antlers above a robust but leggy cervid, not a moose with a bulbous drooping muzzle, reindeer with many thin twig branches, or a generic deer scaled up.

Each antler has a stout pedicle/beam connection, a curved lateral beam, a separated basal/brow projection and a broad flattened distal palm with a handful of unequal tapered points and deep readable notches. Use a shallow compound curve and finite thickness, never a paper plane, solid oval paddle, repeated triangular comb or ring of cones.

Keep palm faces readable from front/oblique views and their thickness/fore-aft sweep readable from top and side. Antlers must remain clear of the ears, skull and opposite antler; do not fill the large negative spaces with a solid plate.

A shaped chest, robust rising neck, modest elevated withers and lower rump form continuous deliberate transitions; the shoulder support must not become an exaggerated bison/camel hump. Use a leaner abdomen behind the deep rib cage.

An elongated cervid head narrows toward a small dark muzzle, with lateral eyes, two leaf-shaped ears below the antler bases, a defined jaw transition, small tail and four anatomically bent legs terminating in paired cloven hooves.

Resolve shoulders, hips, wrists/hocks and ankle taper with custom loft/profile topology. No assembly of untouched spheres, capsules or uniform cylinders for the body and limbs. All four limbs remain distinct and weight-bearing.

Original warm earth palette separated by material region, not random per-face noise. Body planes mostly quiet, with geometry concentrated in the muzzle, joints, antler beam-to-palm transition, notches and tips. Do not bake shadows or hide defects with dark materials.

texture_policy.reason: A restrained original palette is sufficient for this silhouette-led asset; geometry cannot be replaced by painted structure.

website_render_plan.detail_preview_reuse: Not claimed at prep: current release renderer/camera/config hashes have not been verified for this candidate. Retain canonical views; reuse only if actual integration contract and visual adequacy are verified.
website_render_plan.wheel_768x432: Deferred to integration if actually needed; do not render it during prep or routine maker/QA.
